title: Why hierarchy creates a destructive force within the human psyche (by dr. Robert Sapolsky)
summary: A short clip of Robert Sapolsky on how social hierarchy generates chronic stress, drawing on baboon research. It links rank-related stress to heart health and life expectancy.
why: HN shares it as a compact explanation of how hierarchy and stress affect health, pointing to the longer full lecture.

quote.text: Here's Sapolsky explaining how stress in an hierarchical social arrangement impacts heart health and life expectancy.
